deck.name: Linear algebra basics
deck.description: Definitions and a few quick checks.

cards.front: What is the determinant of $\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$?
Compute a dot product in NumPy.

cards.question: Which matrix is the identity $I_2$?
cards.explanation: $I_2$ has ones on the diagonal and zeros elsewhere, so $I_2 A = A$.

cards.question: Which of these are always true for square matrices $A$ and $B$?
cards.explanation: Matrix multiplication isn't commutative, and the determinant isn't additive.
